questions.displayText:
If you are currently experiencing thoughts of harming yourself or suicide, it's important to seek help as soon as possible.

  • Contact NHS 111 or your GP for advice
  • You can call Samaritans free on 116 123 for confidential support (available 24 hours a day)
  • If you feel you are in immediate danger, call 999 or go to A&E

answerChoices.displayText: I understand that if I am currently experiencing thoughts of self-harm or suicide I should seek medical advice immediately
